title: JC said Navy running Majestic 12 was right

tellings.quote: things he said we got right is we had the the guy running Majestic 12 be from the Navy.

plain: In Los Angeles around 1996, a source known only as JC is said to have told Bryce Zabel, who made a story about Majestic 12, that one detail was right: the man running it came from the Navy. Majestic 12 is the name given to a supposed secret group of officials in charge of the UFO question. Zabel tells Michels this from his own experience, recalling that JC said 'we had the guy running Majestic 12 be from the Navy.' If it were true, a piece of fiction would have matched how the real group was run.
